credit: She ruled for twenty years — daughter, queen, then regent in her son’s name — while Europe kept sending armies east. Find the word for what brought them.
The work will not be completed in your lifetime, said Rabbi Tarfon, and that is no excuse to abandon it. Find the word that means both a commandment and a kindness.
Pharaoh’s answer to Moses was to make the work harder and supply nothing to do it with. Find the word for the Egyptian monuments that have loomed over the story ever since.
The roads filled three times a year with people walking up to the Temple, singing as they climbed. Find the word for those who made the journey.
Hammered from a single talent of gold, six branches off a central stem, its cups shaped like almond blossom. Find the word for the lamp itself.
He came out in bronze with a spear like a weaver’s beam, and was answered by a boy with five smooth stones and no armour at all. Find the name he is still remembered by.
